from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.DebateWithModerator(worker_llm=self.llm, moderator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, agent_prompts=[prompt_custom.GRID_DEBATE_AGENT] * 3, moderator_prompt=prompt_custom.GRID_DEBATE_MODERATOR, n_rounds=2)
        draft = await debate(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=2, prompts=[prompt_custom.GRID_AUDIT_STEP, prompt_custom.GRID_RENDER_STEP])
        solution = await seq(f"{problem}\n\nCandidate solution:\n{draft['response']}")
        return solution['response'], {"worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(), "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()}

Rules:
- Deduce the left-to-right arrangement using all clues.
- Compare your reasoning against other proposals if present.

{problem}

- Ask for exact left-to-right positions when disagreements remain.
- On the final round, output the best fully consistent solution in the same row-oriented category table requested by the puzzle.

{problem}

Proposals:
